culprit_citations.quoted_text: Ratio of net investment income to average Members' Capital (4) | 9.11 %

rationale: F16 compares distribution_rate to income_yield_pct * 1.5. The flagged observed distribution rate is 8.736047%, while the filing discloses a 2025 ratio of net investment income to average Members' Capital of 9.11%, giving a threshold of 13.665%. The same financial highlights and distribution schedule disclose 2025 distributions of about 1.67 per unit / 312.944 million, consistent with an approximately 8.8% distribution rate. The raw source therefore does not show distributions exceeding income yield by the rule standard; the fail appears driven by a bad income-yield anchor/check input.
